events.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.

events.text: Could you turn all five attached pictures—the dog pic, the surprised cat pic, the two friends pic, the woman's portrait, and the lake pic—into a reel for me? I thought it would be nice to do something with these pictures instead of just leaving them sitting around. What I mean is one 8-second vertical 9:16 reel using the whole set. Make it fun, and you can pick the vibe, the order, the editing style, any music, sound effects or voice, and any captions, wording or language. I'm curious to see what you come up with because I don't really have a particular vision in mind.
